title: Sum of Imbalance Numbers of All Subarrays
summary: Calculate the sum of imbalance numbers for all subarrays in a given integer array.
statement: Calculate the sum of imbalance numbers for all subarrays in a given integer array. An imbalance number is the count of indices in the sorted version of the array where the difference between consecutive elements exceeds one.
constraints: For each nonempty subarray, sort its distinct values.
Its imbalance is the number of adjacent sorted pairs whose difference exceeds one.
Return the sum of imbalance values over all subarrays.
hints: For a fixed left endpoint, extend the right endpoint while tracking distinct values.
Distinct integers form consecutive components; imbalance equals components minus one.
A new value creates one component and merges with each present neighbor value-1 and value+1.
The component update exactly tracks gaps in sorted distinct values, so adding components-1 for every endpoint yields the required sum.
